Title: Embedding/Accessing Event Calendar from Third Party Sites

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body: I'd like to be able to add upcoming US events and online events in the US timezones to KGS Cards site. I think this would help promote the card and potentially encourage retailers. Is there a way to access the calendar externally? An embed code or RSS feed, for instance.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I have been adding lately some APIs to retrieve data such as events, but they are still in beta. Drop me an email so we can discuss about it.
